== Notes ==
* The damage from Scourge Healing is applied before the heal.  This means that it's possible to kill oneself by using a [[self heal|self-healing]] skill while hexed by Scourge Healing, if it deals more damage than you have [[health]] remaining.
* This skill only affects skills that directly heal (e.g. [[Ether Feast]] or [[Healing Signet]]). It does not affect health gain via [[Divine Favor]] or [[life stealing]], indirect healing via [[Divine Boon]], [[health regeneration]], or similar effects.
{{anomaly| This hex does not trigger for [[Heal Area]], [[Karei's Healing Circle]], and [[Healing Ring]].}}
